personality: 3 Editorial structure with 4 Tactile / Playful surfaces
personality_one_liner: A warm, calming, and highly trustworthy space that embraces neurodivergent families through soft structure, earthy tones, and friendly tactile elements.

spacing.rule: Generous comfortable padding; maintain breathing room for a calming effect. Avoid dense layouts.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism to maintain the solid, trustworthy tactile editorial feel requested.

screens.name: SignIn
screens.purpose: Welcomes users with a calming aesthetic and simple authentication options.

states.error: Standard alert or inline red text for failed auth.

screens.layout: Hero image/texture spanning the top 40% with a vertical gradient scrim blending into the surface. Bold serif 'Welcome back!' header. Stacked pill buttons for sign-in options.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Displays a feed of nearby playdates, emphasizing safety, matching scores, and neurodivergent-friendly environments.

states.empty: Sage green textured empty state with a 'No playdates found' illustration and 'Create a playdate' CTA.
states.error: Error message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Header with user greeting. A trust-strip banner pinned near the bottom stating 'All families are verified'. Scrollable list of rounded soft cards. Cards feature image top, age-range pill badge overlaid in dark teal, title, circular category icons, and 'Request to Join' pill CTA at the bottom right. Bottom tabs for navigation.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: Allows users to filter and search playdates by specific sensory preferences, interests, and age ranges.

states.empty: Illustration indicating no matches for current filters.

screens.layout: Grid of category bubbles and filter chips using brand colors. Search bar at the top.

screens.name: FamilyProfile
screens.purpose: Displays detailed profile of a family/child including sensory preferences, match score, and verification status.

states.empty: Prompt to fill out family profile details.

screens.layout: Cover image at the top. Circular avatar. Prominent 'Match Score' pill. Sections for 'Sensory Preferences' and 'Interests' displayed as colored chips. Large 'Verified' trust badge. 'Block & Report' utility pinned at the bottom.

hero_nature.alt: Quiet nature park serving as a calming hero backdrop

playdate_art.alt: Kids participating in a quiet art class

empty_state_texture.alt: Calming sage green texture for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the provided color palette. DO NOT introduce AI-slop purples, indigos, or generic blues. Use the dark teal (#264653) as your contrasting dark neutral for text and heavy elements.
Typography: Use Fraunces for bold, trustworthy serif headings ('Welcome back!') and DM Sans for clean, legible body text and UI labels. Ensure font weights never exceed 500.

Playdate Cards: Cards must have rounded corners (lg radius) and subtle shadows (tier 1). Playdate images should feature an overlaid age-range pill badge with a dark teal (#264653) background and white text.

Icons and Badges: Circular category icons should use the brand primary, secondary, or tertiary colors as their backgrounds. Use Feather icons for a clean, outline aesthetic (including the bookmark icon on cards).
Actions: 'Request to Join' buttons should be distinct, colored pills (using brandPrimary or brandSecondary).
Navigation: Implement 4 bottom tabs (Home, Explore, Messages, Profile). Explicitly use `NativeTabs` via Expo Router for iOS targets if supported, falling back to standard tabs.

Trust & Safety elements are key: Pin a 'All families are verified' trust strip near the bottom of the Home screen. Ensure Match Scores and Verification Badges are prominent on profiles. Always include Block & Report functionalities on user profiles.
All images used as backdrops or with text over them must use a gradient scrim (transparent to dark teal or black) to guarantee minimum WCAG AA contrast for text overlays.
Ensure Loading, Empty, and Error states are implemented gracefully across all data-fetching screens.
